description: Start registration of a new TronRental account. Requires the user's REAL email — ask the user, never invent one: TronRental mails a 6-digit code there and the account is created only when that code is passed to verify_email_code. If the email already has an account, use login.

email.description: The user's own email: they will read the code from it

language.description: Language of the email (en, ru, zh, ko, …)

password.description: Min 8 chars with an uppercase, a lowercase letter and a digit

name: register
